dialogues.jp: ぐぃ、と美春が目をつりあげる。
dialogues.en: Miharu has a fierce look in her eyes.
dialogues.text: Miharu has a fierce look in her eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「『病院ではお静かに』……だって、あの看護
　師さん」
dialogues.en: "The nurse said to be quiet in the patient's room."
dialogues.text: "The nurse said to be quiet in the patient's room."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あはは」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha!"
dialogues.text: "Hahaha!"

dialogues.jp:
見舞いにきてくれたふたりを、音夢がぼう、と
見つめる。
dialogues.en:
Nemu looks vaguely at the two girls paying her a visit at
the hospital.
dialogues.text:
Nemu looks vaguely at the two girls paying her a visit at
the hospital.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「でも音夢先輩って、寝るときは病院でもシャ
　ツなんですねぇ」
dialogues.en: "Whoa, you wear a shirt even in the hospital bed?"
dialogues.text: "Whoa, you wear a shirt even in the hospital bed?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、俺も驚いた」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, I'm impressed, too."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, I'm impressed, too."

dialogues.jp:
看護師さんも呆れたものだが、音夢はあのシャ
ツ以外のものを着るのを子供みたいに嫌がった
のだ。
dialogues.en:
The nurses are amazed at her as well, but Nemu thinks the
other kind of clothes make her look childish.
dialogues.text:
The nurses are amazed at her as well, but Nemu thinks the
other kind of clothes make her look childish.

dialogues.jp:
音夢の目が覚めたと病院から連絡を受けたとき、
音夢を心配した眞子と美春がちょうど家に来た
のだ。
dialogues.en:
When I got a call from the hospital that Nemu had just waken
up, I came over, along with Mako and Miharu who were
visiting because they were worried about Nemu's condition.
dialogues.text:
When I got a call from the hospital that Nemu had just waken
up, I came over, along with Mako and Miharu who were
visiting because they were worried about Nemu's condition.

dialogues.jp: 「しかし美春よ……これは……」
dialogues.en: "But, Miharu. This is..."
dialogues.text: "But, Miharu. This is..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「お見舞いです！」
dialogues.en: "Pay her a visit!"
dialogues.text: "Pay her a visit!"

dialogues.jp: ごわごわとした新聞に包まれた――。
dialogues.en: Something wrapped with rough newspaper...
dialogues.text: Something wrapped with rough newspaper...

dialogues.jp: 「……バナナだな」
dialogues.en: "It must be bananas."
dialogues.text: "It must be bananas."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉先輩、エスパー！？」
dialogues.en: "Wow, Asakura-sempai, are you psychic?!"
dialogues.text: "Wow, Asakura-sempai, are you psychic?!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「お前の見舞いの品に関してはエスパーだ」
dialogues.en: "When it comes to gifts, I am."
dialogues.text: "When it comes to gifts, I am."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ほぇ〜」
dialogues.en: "Whoa..."
dialogues.text: "Whoa..."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「いや、入院したって聞いて心配したけど、思っ
　たより顔色がよくて安心したよ」
dialogues.en:
"I was worried when I heard you were hospitalized, but I'm
glad you look better than I thought."
dialogues.text:
"I was worried when I heard you were hospitalized, but I'm
glad you look better than I thought."

dialogues.jp:
俺達が漫才をしている間に、眞子はベッドに腰
掛けて音夢の手をとっていた。
dialogues.en:
While Miharu and I are doing a comedy routine, Mako's
holding Nemu's hand, sitting on the bed.
dialogues.text:
While Miharu and I are doing a comedy routine, Mako's
holding Nemu's hand, sitting on the bed.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あ、美春も、ものすご〜く心配してました
　よ！！」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I was so worried about you!!"
dialogues.text: "Oh, I was so worried about you!!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「はいはい」
dialogues.en: "Okay, okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay, okay."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どうした音夢？」
dialogues.en: "What's wrong, Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "What's wrong, Nemu?"

dialogues.jp:
見事なバナナを棚に置きながら、さきほどから
一言も口をきかない妹を見る。
dialogues.en:
Putting the gorgeous bananas on the shelf, I look at my
sister, who hasn't spoken for a while.
dialogues.text:
Putting the gorgeous bananas on the shelf, I look at my
sister, who hasn't spoken for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ……うん」
dialogues.en: "Uh... mm."
dialogues.text: "Uh... mm."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「もぉ、この不肖美春、音夢先輩のことが心配
　で心配で、昨日からバナナしか喉を通りませ
　んでしたよ」
dialogues.en:
"I've been so worried about you, o great Nemu-sempai, that
since yesterday I haven't been able to eat anything but
bananas."
dialogues.text:
"I've been so worried about you, o great Nemu-sempai, that
since yesterday I haven't been able to eat anything but
bananas."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……お前も喉と胃を検査してもらえ」
dialogues.en:
"Why don't you ask a doctor to check your throat and
stomach?"
dialogues.text:
"Why don't you ask a doctor to check your throat and
stomach?"

dialogues.jp:
絶対、レントゲンを撮ったらバナナ型の胃袋が
写るはずだ。
dialogues.en: I'm sure they'll see your stomach is shaped like a banana.
dialogues.text: I'm sure they'll see your stomach is shaped like a banana.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「そうそう、遅れたけど、これあたしからのお
　見舞い」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I almost forgot, this is a get-well gift from me."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I almost forgot, this is a get-well gift from me."

dialogues.jp:
白と青い色で揃えられた花束を眞子が差し出し
てくる。
dialogues.en: Mako hands Nemu a flower bouquet in white and blue.
dialogues.text: Mako hands Nemu a flower bouquet in white and blue.

dialogues.jp:
「……中にショットガンとか入ってないだろう
　な」
dialogues.en: "You didn't put a shotgun in there, did you?"
dialogues.text: "You didn't put a shotgun in there, did you?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あんた……本校でも相変わらず元気そうね」
dialogues.en: "You... you're just as lively as always, huh?"
dialogues.text: "You... you're just as lively as always, huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……おかげさまで」
dialogues.en: "Thank you, I am."
dialogues.text: "Thank you, I am."

dialogues.jp: なんとなく後ずさりしながら苦笑いを浮かべた。
dialogues.en: Stepping backwards involuntarily, I give a nervous smile.
dialogues.text: Stepping backwards involuntarily, I give a nervous smile.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　音夢先輩、調子悪いですか？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? What's wrong, Nemu-sempai?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? What's wrong, Nemu-sempai?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「え？　……あ、うんん」
dialogues.en: "What? Uh... uh-huh..."
dialogues.text: "What? Uh... uh-huh..."

dialogues.jp:
なぜか美春と視線を合わせようとせず、音夢が
俺を見つめる。
dialogues.en: Nemu gazes at me, avoiding Miharu's eyes.
dialogues.text: Nemu gazes at me, avoiding Miharu's eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あ、じゃあ美春ちゃん、音夢の顔もみたし、
　そろそろ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, Nemu looks better, so we'd better get going,
Miharu-chan."
dialogues.text:
"Well, Nemu looks better, so we'd better get going,
Miharu-chan."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「はい。お名残惜しいですが帰ります……明日
　も来ますからね、音夢先輩」
dialogues.en: "Sure. It's been nice seeing you - we'll be back tomorrow."
dialogues.text: "Sure. It's been nice seeing you - we'll be back tomorrow."

dialogues.jp:
音夢の手に自分の頬を重ねて、よよよ、と美春
が涙を流す。
dialogues.en: Pulling Nemu's hand to her cheek, Miharu sheds a tear.
dialogues.text: Pulling Nemu's hand to her cheek, Miharu sheds a tear.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「すまないな眞子」
dialogues.en: "Thanks, Mako."
dialogues.text: "Thanks, Mako."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「いや、あんたも無理しないようにね。それじゃ
　また学園で会おうね音夢」
dialogues.en:
"No problem. You've got to take it easy, though. See you at
school, Nemu."
dialogues.text:
"No problem. You've got to take it easy, though. See you at
school, Nemu."

dialogues.jp:
美春の｛えり／襟｝をつかみながら、眞子が部屋を出て行
く。
dialogues.en: Grabbing Miharu's neck, Mako walks out of the room.
dialogues.text: Grabbing Miharu's neck, Mako walks out of the room.

dialogues.jp:
「ははは。相変わらずだったな。これで、さく
　らでも来てたら大変だっただろうけど」
dialogues.en:
"Hahaha. They're the same as usual. But if Sakura were here,
it couldn't be worse."
dialogues.text:
"Hahaha. They're the same as usual. But if Sakura were here,
it couldn't be worse."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……お兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Oniichan..."
dialogues.text: "Oniichan..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どうした？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 少しためらって、音夢が自分の肩を抱く。
dialogues.en: Nemu holds her own shoulders hesitantly.
dialogues.text: Nemu holds her own shoulders hesitantly.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あの人たち……誰？」
dialogues.en: "Who are they?"
dialogues.text: "Who are they?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんで私のシャツのこととか知ってるの？」
dialogues.en: "Why do they know about my shirt?"
dialogues.text: "Why do they know about my shirt?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんでって……お前……まさか……」
dialogues.en: "'Why'...? You... Oh, no..."
dialogues.text: "'Why'...? You... Oh, no..."

dialogues.jp:
それはまるで一昨日の、過去のクラスメイトを
覚えていなかった俺のように。
dialogues.en:
It reminds me of two days ago when I couldn't remember my
classmates at all.
dialogues.text:
It reminds me of two days ago when I couldn't remember my
classmates at all.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「学園で会おうってなに？　どうして？」
dialogues.en: "They said they'll see me at school, but why?"
dialogues.text: "They said they'll see me at school, but why?"

dialogues.jp: 震えている。
dialogues.en: She is shaking.
dialogues.text: She is shaking.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「私、どうしてココにいるの？」
dialogues.en: "Why am I here?"
dialogues.text: "Why am I here?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Who is Sakura!?"
dialogues.text: "Who is Sakura!?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
『自己を失ってまでお兄ちゃんとの思い出を手
　放したくないの？』
dialogues.en:
'You don't want to lose all your memories with him by dying
yourself, do you?'
dialogues.text:
'You don't want to lose all your memories with him by dying
yourself, do you?'

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「助けて……」
dialogues.en: "Help me..."
dialogues.text: "Help me..."

dialogues.jp: 音夢が俺の首にしがみつく。
dialogues.en: Nemu clings to my neck.
dialogues.text: Nemu clings to my neck.

dialogues.jp: 鈴が鳴る。
dialogues.en: Her bell rings.
dialogues.text: Her bell rings.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「助けてお兄ちゃん――！」
dialogues.en: "Help me, oniichan!"
dialogues.text: "Help me, oniichan!"

dialogues.jp: ◆失われた記憶◆
dialogues.en: ◆Lost memories◆
dialogues.text: ◆Lost memories◆

dialogues.jp:
音夢が入院している病室に、美春と眞子がお見
舞いにきてくれた。
dialogues.en: Miharu and Mako paid a visit to Nemu in the hospital.
dialogues.text: Miharu and Mako paid a visit to Nemu in the hospital.

dialogues.jp:
そんな友達の心配や心が嬉しかったが、なぜか、
音夢はふたりのことを覚えていなかった――。
dialogues.en:
Nemu was grateful for their thoughtfulness, but she didn't
remember anything about them.
dialogues.text:
Nemu was grateful for their thoughtfulness, but she didn't
remember anything about them.

dialogues.jp:
そして、俺のことも兄さんではなく、お兄ちゃ
んと呼び出した……。
dialogues.en:
Moreover, she started to call me not 'niisan' but
'oniichan'.
dialogues.text:
Moreover, she started to call me not 'niisan' but
'oniichan'.

dialogues.jp:
それはまるで、過去の出来事を忘れている俺の
状態とそっくりだった。
dialogues.en:
It was exactly the same situation as when I couldn't
remember my past.
dialogues.text:
It was exactly the same situation as when I couldn't
remember my past.
